llm_summary: When Canva announced a restructuring that would cut 1,271 jobs—about 22 % of its staff—the focus quickly shifted to the severance package it offered departing employees. The article argues that, especially for fast‑growing tech firms, the legal minimum isn’t enough; companies should provide more generous, humane exit terms that reflect the talent they’ve built and the disruption employees face.
